note: Rule rec_shop_early from output/research/props_full.md / props_full_frozen.json (developed on 2023: 87 bets, CLV +1.3%; one-shot holdout 2024-25: 278 bets, CLV +2.74% +- 0.40 (game-clustered, t 6.9), +1.6% in 2024 and +3.7% in 2025; realized ROI -6.0% +- 6.5, hit 44%, ~6.5 bets/week; 98% of CLV measured at the same point at the close). Caveats from the study: picked from 5 markets x thresholds of shop rules (other markets ~-1% CLV in dev); the no-vig close overrates overs (shading by the 2023 under bias leaves +2.3%); prop limits/account restrictions are not modelled. Production has no projection model, so it also bets players outside the research's modelled universe (replaying 2023-25 research quotes with the production code: the same 365 bets, same book/point/side, plus 16 such player-games, ~4%). Paper track only. Do not edit to fit results; bump version instead.

qualify.snapshot: Friday 21:40 UTC run for games kicking off on a Sunday (UTC date); kickoff - 24 h for every other game (research 'early' snapshot)
qualify.fair_probability: leave-one-out median no-vig probability (multiplicative) of the OTHER books (regions=us, allowed or not) quoting the SAME player and point at this snapshot
qualify.one_bet_per_player: best-EV side/book/point among the allowed books (my_books.json); if that best quote's EV is outside [min_ev, max_ev) there is no bet
qualify.bet: the side (over/under) at the allowed book whose price beats the fair probability by EV >= 2%

grading.close: our last props snapshot of the event taken 10-90 min before kickoff (fetched only for games with open bets), <= 3 h before kickoff
grading.clv: decimal price x median no-vig probability of our side among close books quoting the SAME point - 1 (research 'direct' CLV); no same-point close quote = no CLV (the research's model-anchored fallback, 2% of bets, needs the projection model and is not used)
grading.result: nflverse weekly player stats (stats_player release) receptions vs the point; a player without a stat line who took >= 1 offensive snap (snap counts) has 0; no offensive snap = void

cost: Odds API per-event call (markets=player_receptions, regions=us) = ~1 credit per event: one per game at its early window, plus ~1-2 per game with open bets near kickoff
